name: services/grades/terms2
description: Get grades of a user on given terms
brief_description: Get grades of a user on given terms

arguments.name: term_ids
arguments.description: pipe-separated list of academic term ids

arguments.name: course_ids
arguments.description: pipe-separated list of course ids to limit results further

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector must contain subset of primary fields, which are described in the returns section of grade method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: Multilevel dictionary mapping term_id and course_id to object returned by course_edition2. If term_id given in the term_ids param does not exist it will be mapped to Null.

result_fields.name: course_grades
result_fields.description: Dictionary describing grades related to course edition's main exam. Returned dictionary will have structure as defined in exam method, or null if course edition is not related with any exam report

result_fields.name: course_units_grades
result_fields.description: Dictionary mapping course unit ID that are related to exam report to dictionaries describing exam grades as defined in exam method
